title: RuleHost seed-MVP Performance Baseline
description: PRI-496: Recorded baseline for gate-rule-host-perf-budget.test.ts and rule-context-v2.perf.test.ts. These numbers are NOT thresholds — they are measured baselines for regression detection. Contract thresholds (enforced in CI) are documented in docs/runbooks/ops/rulehost-seed-mvp-playbook.md §10.3.

contractThresholds.rationale: Spec aspirational target is 50ms/200ms; CI enforces 200ms/500ms due to Windows FS overhead + SQLite concurrent load. ERR-088 BLOCK_MARKER proves rule executed (not silent skip).

scenarios.name: gate-rule-host-perf-budget.test.ts: production hook (100 iterations)
scenarios.description: Full handleBeforeToolCall with real SQLite activation + v2 flag + RuleHost load + VM compile. ERR-088: asserts PERF_BASELINE_BLOCK marker on every iteration.

contractCheck.note: p95/p99 well within 200ms/500ms contract; max spike 192.66ms likely Windows FS cache miss.

scenarios.name: rule-context-v2.perf.test.ts: production hook (100 iterations)
scenarios.description: Production hook including SQLite load and VM compilation (broader sanity bound 500ms/1000ms).

scenarios.name: rule-context-v2.perf.test.ts: context query (100 rows, 100 iterations)
scenarios.description: buildProductionRuleContext p50/p95 over 100 iterations with 100 history rows.

scenarios.name: rule-context-v2.perf.test.ts: cold-start (first recordToolCall + schema init)
scenarios.description: First recordToolCall on a fresh workspace — triggers SQLite schema initialization.

scenarios.name: rule-context-v2.perf.test.ts: empty-history query (100 iterations)
scenarios.description: Baseline overhead: buildProductionRuleContext with empty history.

notes: These baselines were recorded on Windows 10 (10.0.26200) with Node v24.14.0.
Linux CI numbers will likely be lower (3-5x faster SQLite FS).
Update this file after any major architecture change (e.g., cache layer rewrite, SQLite schema migration).
Contract thresholds are in the test files (toBeLessThan calls) and documented in playbook §10.3.
